primary_claim: Real GPT-2 activations cannot be reproduced by a structureless 'bag of SAE latents': synthetic activations built only from latent sparsity/activation values show a much smaller sensitivity-based blowup gap to random activations than real activations do, while incorporating SAE latents' pairwise cosine-similarity geometry ('synthetic-structured') closes much of this gap, showing that SAE latent geometry matters for reconstructing real model computation.

effect.metric: model sensitivity (max-slope perturbation step) gap between synthetic and real activations

quote: real activations cannot be mimicked using a bag of SAE latents with no internal structure, and that geometric and statistical properties of SAE latents play an important role
